basis: one source-native model contains two coupled nonlinear pitch-yaw closed-loop branches for noisy/noise-free comparison
state estimation, disturbance/noise rejection, cross-axis rotor actuation, and actuator saturation
two independently effective intervention families: attitude-command excursion and measurement-noise covariance
five private conditions expose tracking, coupling, observer consistency, noise rejection, saturation, and recovery tradeoffs

A.meaning: pitch/yaw angle and rate trajectory accuracy in both branches

Q.meaning: finite complete exact-width ten-second output contract

M.meaning: coupled nonlinear plant, dynamic actuation, estimator, and branch-divergence fidelity

C.meaning: command and measurement-noise intervention causality plus closed-loop tracking

R.meaning: worst private-condition behavior and numerical robustness

D.meaning: startup, transient, recovery, and terminal-rate fidelity

score_policy.within_group: task-specific arithmetic aggregation with explicit worst-condition retention
score_policy.across_groups: weighted geometric mean; absent critical mechanism groups may be zero

minimum_shortcut_sanity_contract: one scenario replayed for all interventions
noisy branch copied from noise-free branch
